name: Race GC

origin.basis: CADEX is the Giant Group's component brand (its site footer links to Giant Group); Giant Group was founded in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: CADEX does not state where the tire is made.

positioning: Lightweight CADEX tubeless tire balancing speed, cornering grip and durability, with a 240 TPI casing.

availability.note: Sold by CADEX's US web store; Giant and CADEX stores in other regions were not checked for this model.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

caveats: The 30 mm size is offered, but the page gives specifications for 28 mm only.
